coordinates: MJCF Z-up; export glTF p=(x,z,-y), quaternion xyzw
dynamicBinding: Every named non-world MuJoCo body is exported; glTF node name must exactly match body name, geometry local to body origin. Include hoist_carrier as a dynamic body.
mirror: Right robot, bracket, pin and magazine are the left assemblies rotated pi around world Z about (9,-12); names gain _right. Beam bore right is local half-turn about Z.

connector.type: free pin with opposed spring dogs; annular lug contact

limitations: Ideal robot rail grip welds only; no fastening equality
Prescribed crane carrier; tension-only compliant slings
Concept tool/magazine geometry and rigid workcell; not certified hardware
